Tower

Material
Reclaimed pallet wood
Size
40 × 2 × 2 ft
Status
Rendering, design development

A rendered model of a tower of stacked crates, 40 feet tall and 2 × 2 feet in plan, built from reclaimed pallet wood. The photograph is a sample crate I built to scale. The tower itself is in design development.
